pages.title: Welcome!
pages.text: This mod turns passive animals into a living, breathing livestock simulation. Animals have genders, hunger, diets, pregnancy, and even eggs that hatch.$(br2)To get started, hold any food in your hand and right-click an animal. That's it!
Cows are herbivores. Feed them wheat, hay, apples, or any crop.

pages.title: Why Animals Run Away
pages.text: Wild animals will flee when you approach! Sneak up to them or chase them into a corner. Once you feed them, they become domesticated and will no longer run away.

pages.title: Panic Is Contagious
pages.text: Fleeing is contagious! The moment one animal is startled and starts to flee, every other animal that would flee ($(bold)of any species$()) within $(bold)10 blocks$() is startled into running too.$(br2)So do not expect to spook one cow and sneak past the sheep next to it - the whole pen will scatter.$(br2)Already domesticated animals are not swept up by this wave of panic.
